description: This file defines the PHPMailer class, a PHP class for sending emails via sendmail, SMTP, or PHP mail(). It includes methods for setting email headers, recipients, attachments, encoding, and sending emails, as well as handling errors and SMTP connections.

classes.name: PHPMailer
classes.description: A PHP class for composing and sending emails via sendmail, SMTP, or PHP mail() with support for attachments, encoding, headers, and error handling.

methods.name: IsHTML
methods.description: Sets the email content type to HTML or plain text.

methods.name: IsSMTP
methods.description: Configures the class to send email via SMTP.

methods.name: IsMail
methods.description: Configures the class to use PHP mail() function.

methods.name: IsSendmail
methods.description: Configures the class to use sendmail.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Creates and sends the email message using the configured mailer.

methods.name: SendmailSend
methods.description: Sends email using the sendmail program.

methods.name: MailSend
methods.description: Sends email using PHP mail() function.

methods.name: SetLanguage
methods.description: Sets the language for error messages.

methods.name: SetMessageType
methods.description: Determines message type based on attachments and body.

methods.name: AttachAll
methods.description: Attaches all files and strings to the email.

methods.name: EncodeString
methods.description: Encodes a string for email transmission.

methods.name: AddStringAttachment
methods.description: Adds a string as an attachment.

methods.name: InlineImageExists
methods.description: Checks if inline images are attached.
